stories.title: Ewloe, Flint and Bagillt among Flintshire roads hit by closures this week
stories.summary: A roundabout in Ewloe will stay partly closed until 25 May as work continues on a £900,000 Active Travel scheme, with drivers diverted via Wood Lane. The St David’s Park Road arm of St David’s roundabout was shut to traffic from 8am on 5 May and is due to reopen at 8am on 25 May,

stories.title: BAFTA-winner Richard Elfyn leads cast of new Atlantis play at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A new play about a Welsh coastal community facing rising seas will run at Theatr Clwyd in Mold from 6 June to 4 July. stories.title: Foster Care Fortnight launches in Flintshire as council seeks more local carers
stories.summary: Foster Care Fortnight launches in Flintshire on Monday, with Flintshire County Council and Foster Wales urging more local families to consider becoming foster carers. stories.title: Ewloe holiday park operator Darwin Escapes launches lodge sales business
stories.summary: Holiday park operator Darwin Escapes, which is headquartered at St David’s Park in Ewloe, has put 10 lodges up for sale in its first move into holiday home ownership. stories.title: The winners and losers of the 2026 Senedd election
